newsitem.title: USA: LME to consider board changes at next meeting.
newsitem.headline: LME to consider board changes at next meeting.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) has proposed changes to the structure of its board, which have been circulated to interested parties and their responses asked for, industry sources said Tuesday.
After the 1996 Securities Investment Board (SIB) review of LME, the UK regulator made several recommendations for change -- one of which was regarding the LME's governance and board structure.

The industry sources, who are attending New York Copper Club events this week, said they were formulating their responses and will be presenting them to the LME prior to the exchange's regular monthly board meeting.
The board meeting was originally scheduled for Wednesday this week but has been switched to Friday.
